review_comment: The patch enables extensions without the previous existence validation, but evidence doesn't establish that the extension source is actually untrusted or outside the intended control sphere. The removal of the ExtensionUtils.extensions[uuid] check weakens validation, but without demonstrating untrusted source or concrete impact, this appears to be a validation weakening rather than confirmed untrusted functionality inclusion. Consider restoring the existence check or implementing comprehensive extension validation including signature verification and source attestation.
